$base = "D:\repository"
$repos = @('苏州市房地产监测V3','无锡市区G','惠山小程序','淮安物管','家园区一网通办')
foreach ($repo in $repos) {
  $g = Join-Path $base $repo
  $branch = git -C $g rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null
  $upstream = git -C $g rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name "@{u}" 2>$null
  if (-not $upstream) { $upstream = "(no upstream)" }
  $staged = (git -C $g diff --cached --name-only 2>$null) -join ", "
  Write-Output "### $repo"
  Write-Output "  branch=$branch  upstream=$upstream"
  Write-Output "  staged: $staged"
  Write-Output ""
}
